name: doomgeneric
verification: The extracted 211-file archive was force-added to a temporary Git index; git write-tree returned the upstream git_tree value. The temporary nested Git metadata was then removed.

local_modifications.reason: Narrow the upstream executable ignore rule so the vendored source directory remains trackable in this repository.

Bound sprite-column wrapping to the cached patch lump and use palette index zero only when a wrapped sample would leave that allocation. This eliminates allocator- and architecture-dependent out-of-bounds reads while preserving vanilla reads elsewhere inside the lump and ordinary wall-column wrapping.
